e.title: Outliers in Loss Reserving (UNSW)
e.summary: 异常值对损失准备金影响的论文代码（Avanzi/Lavender/Taylor/Wong，arXiv 2203.00184）
e.body: reserving-impact-factors 是论文《On the impact of outliers in loss reserving》（Avanzi, Lavender, Taylor, Wong，arXiv:2203.00184）的代码：系统研究异常值对损失准备金的影响——哪些数据点、什么程度的异常会多大程度扭曲准备金估计。对 RIAA：理解『为什么准备金数据清洗重要』的量化研究。UNSW agi-lab 系列，与 [[reserving-robust]]（检测与处理）互补。关联 [[chainladder]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：arXiv 2203.00184（Avanzi/Lavender/Taylor/Wong），异常值对准备金影响，UNSW Actuarial Software Directory 收录
e.summary_en: Paper code on the impact of outliers in loss reserving (Avanzi/Lavender/Taylor/Wong, arXiv 2203.00184)
e.summary_hk: 異常值對損失準備金影響的論文代碼（Avanzi/Lavender/Taylor/Wong，arXiv 2203.00184）
e.body_en: reserving-impact-factors is the code of the paper 'On the impact of outliers in loss reserving' (Avanzi, Lavender, Taylor, Wong; arXiv:2203.00184): a systematic study of how outliers affect loss reserving — which data points and how much distortion outliers cause to reserve estimates. For RIAA: a quantitative study of 'why reserving data cleaning matters'. UNSW agi-lab series, complementing [[reserving-robust]] (detection and treatment). Related: [[chainladder]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reserving-ensemble]].
e.body_hk: reserving-impact-factors 是論文《On the impact of outliers in loss reserving》（Avanzi, Lavender, Taylor, Wong，arXiv:2203.00184）的代碼：系統研究異常值對損失準備金的影響——哪些數據點、什麼程度的異常會多大程度扭曲準備金估計。對 RIAA：理解『為什麼準備金數據清洗重要』的量化研究。UNSW agi-lab 系列，與 [[reserving-robust]]（檢測與處理）互補。關聯 [[chainladder]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]。
